info.name: Ducker ID API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Ducker ID server (`/api/v1/*`, the root-mounted OIDC routes and `/health`).

## Structure
- **01 · Happy Path** — each endpoint called the normal way. Folders are in run order: log in first, Logout last.
- **02 · Edge & Error Cases** — validation (400), auth (401/403), not found (404), conflict (409), rate limits (429), OAuth errors.

Each request has a test asserting its expected status code(s), so the folders can be run in the Collection Runner.

## Before running
1. Seed the database (`pnpm seed`) — use a dev/seed DB, never real data: some happy-path calls lock/reset user2 and create apps/categories.
2. Run **01 · Happy Path › 01 · Login** first — it stores `adminAccessToken` / `userAccessToken` and puts the `refreshToken` + `sid` cookies in Postman's cookie jar.
3. Requests tagged **[manual: var]** need a one-time code from the email (codes are only stored as bcrypt hashes) — set the variable first.

## Notes
- Validation errors answer **400** (`ValidationError`), not 422.
- OIDC endpoints are at the origin root, not under `/api/v1`, and answer in the RFC shape `{ error, error_description }` (no envelope).
- `language` (en | vi) sets `Accept-Language` on every request.
